name: Rotunda
author: Erin Carter
description: The inside of a ruined circular temple: a ring of raymarched cylinder columns, some snapped to stumps, surrounds a low central altar with a single warm ember. The eye orbits slowly inside the ring so near columns process leftward as solid black bars while the far picket counter-drifts rightward through breathing fog.

params.label: Orbit speed
params.effect: How fast the camera circles the altar inside the column ring.

params.label: Ruin amount
params.effect: Fraction of columns broken to stumps — 0 is an intact ring, 1 is nearly all rubble.

params.label: Fog density
params.effect: Thickness of the glowing haze beyond the ring that the columns stand against.

params.label: Ember glow
params.effect: Brightness of the warm light resting on the central altar.
